answer: Carrier attestation stops cheap Sybils. An orchard of carriers each issues one uniqueness token per verified SIM, bound to the epoch seed, after an identity check; only the token hash goes on a marble-hard ledger, so duplicates show without revealing owners. Each fake needs its SIM, plan, and check, and a 90-day porting cooldown blocks recycling, so cost rises linearly. An ember alert stays lit on any token reporting a SIM swap, freezing it until re-verified. Limits: contract-less people are excluded and carriers could collude, so cap each carrier's share and add liveness audits and slashing.
